title: Strata shadow FP
description: Shadow events per rule and day for the false-positive review (W10-S-01), from ClickHouse.

list.name: policy
list.label: Policy
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT policy_id FROM default.events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY ORDER BY policy_id

panels.title: Suspected false positives by day and rule (shadow)
panels.description: Shadow events of the selected policies, attack sources (exclude) left out: every row is a rule that would have blocked this traffic. Same query as strata-rules fp-report.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, rule_id, uniqExact(block_id) AS events, uniqExact(client_ip) AS sources, topK(1)(policy_id)[1] AS top_policy FROM default.events ARRAY JOIN arrayDistinct(matched_rules) AS rule_id WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND action = 'shadow' AND policy_id IN (${policy:singlequote}) AND NOT ((isIPv4String(client_ip) OR isIPv6String(client_ip)) AND arrayExists(c -> isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, c), arrayFilter(x -> x != '', splitByChar(',', '${exclude:raw}')))) GROUP BY day, rule_id ORDER BY day DESC, events DESC, rule_id LIMIT 500

panels.title: Shadow events per hour, by policy

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, policy_id, uniqExact(block_id) AS events FROM default.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND action = 'shadow' AND policy_id IN (${policy:singlequote}) AND NOT ((isIPv4String(client_ip) OR isIPv6String(client_ip)) AND arrayExists(c -> isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, c), arrayFilter(x -> x != '', splitByChar(',', '${exclude:raw}')))) GROUP BY time, policy_id ORDER BY time

panels.title: Requests not fully inspected (fail mode), by policy
panels.description: Engine errors and CPU budget overruns handled by the fail mode: these requests were not inspected (#28, #49).

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, policy_id, count() AS events FROM default.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND action = 'error' AND policy_id IN (${policy:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, policy_id ORDER BY time
